review_evidence: Complete unit inventory covers 895 Linglib/Studies files organized by cited linguistic works; 894 files own declarations and 882 files contain 17,014 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.

The unit encodes and checks paper-specific analyses across semantics, syntax, phonology, morphology, pragmatics and related areas, making it a dense prior-art collection rather than test/example noise.

The sole declaration-scan exception, Studies/Musan1995.lean, was inspected directly: it contains detailed source/provenance analysis of lifetime effects and anchors empirical data in the retained typed LinguisticExample corpus, so its searchable scholarly context is intentionally preserved.
